summary: Added three keyword-triggered ECS lint rules and their unit tests. Rules: E3052 (ServiceNetworkConfiguration), E3053 (TaskDefinitionAwsVpc), E3054 (ServiceFargate), in src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ecs/. Tests: three modules under test/unit/rules/resources/ecs/. Results: all 79 ECS tests pass and all 979 rules tests pass, run with PYTHONPATH=src against the prepared venv. Full unit suite: 1537 passed, 1 failed (test_build_graph, needs pygraphviz/pydot, not installed) and test_formatters.py could not be collected (defusedxml missing). Nothing committed. Two fixes made during testing: E3053 port walk now starts from the keyword validator (no stray NetworkMode path segment), and test-side deques are no longer shared across parametrized cases because get_value_from_path consumes them. One test case was rewritten because cfn-lint's condition engine does not reduce Fn::Equals of literals to false. Lines wrapped to 88 columns by hand; black/ruff were not available in the venv.
